name: DKCISSP loopback Juice Shop Standard-profile expected-signal baseline
scope: Observed deterministic built-in HTTP/header checks and one reproducible safe Nuclei header-template signal on the loopback Juice Shop lab, plus required scanner-tool health.

expected_signals.description: An HTTP target should produce the scanner's transport-encryption warning.
expected_signals.title_contains: Target uses HTTP without transport encryption

expected_signals.description: The current Juice Shop lab response is expected to lack Content-Security-Policy.
The current Juice Shop lab response is expected to lack Referrer-Policy.
The current Juice Shop lab response is expected to lack Permissions-Policy.
The local lab response exposes the deprecated Feature-Policy header; the safe Nuclei header template should detect it.

coverage_boundary: The expected-signal percentage applies only to these five observed lab configuration signals. It is not an overall vulnerability detection rate, and this baseline does not assert that all other findings are true or false positives. Revalidate these expectations if the lab configuration or selected Nuclei templates change.
